def FlipAddOne(a,flip): assert t >= 1 and t <= 128 x = bits(a,t) carry = bits(flip,1)[0] invert = carry result = [0] * t for i in range(t): value = x[i] ^ invert result[i] = value ^ carry carry = value & carry return pack(result) def Subtract(a,b): assert w >= 1 and w <= 127 x = bits(a,w) y = bits(b,w) result = [0] * (w + 1) borrow = 0 for i in range(w): parity = x[i] ^ y[i] result[i] = parity ^ borrow borrow = ((1 ^ x[i]) & y[i]) | ((1 ^ parity) & borrow) result[w] = borrow return pack(result) def SDIV(a,b): assert p >= 1 and q >= 1 and p <= 16 and q <= 16 x = bits(a,p) y = bits(b,q) a_sign = x[p - 1] negative = a_sign ^ y[q - 1] x = bits(FlipAddOne

(a,a_sign),p) divisor = FlipAddOne(b,y[q - 1]) quotient = [0] * p remainder = [0] * (q + 1) # Restoring-Division der unsigned Beträge in p festen Stufen. for i in range(p - 1,-1,-1): remainder = [x[i]] + remainder[:q] difference = bits(Subtract(pack(remainder),divisor),q + 2) take = 1 ^ difference[q + 1] for j in range(q + 1): remainder[j] = (difference[j] & take) | (remainder[j] & (1 ^ take)) quotient[i] = take nonzero = 0 for i in range(q): nonzero = nonzero | y[i] # Nur ein positiver Quotient mit gesetztem höchstem Bit läuft über: # MIN_p / -1. Bei b=0 hat div0 Vorrang, overflow bleibt 0. overflow = quotient[p - 1] & (1 ^ negative) & nonzero c = bits(FlipAddOne

(pack(quotient),negative),p) rest = bits(FlipAddOne(pack(remainder[:q]),a_sign),q) for i in range(p): c[i] = c[i] & nonzero for i in range(q): rest[i] = rest[i] & nonzero # Beim Overflow bleibt der modulare Quotient MIN_p erhalten, Rest ist 0. return pack(c + rest + [nonzero & (1 ^ overflow),1 ^ nonzero,overflow]) # Ergebnisports: Quotient p Bits, Rest q Bits, valid, div0, overflow. result = bits(SDIV(a,b),p + q + 3) return pack(result[:p]), pack(result[p:p+q]), result[p+q], result[p+q+1], result[p+q+2]

metadata.description: Zweierkomplement mit expliziter Vorzeichen-Bitlogik, LSB-first; Division gegen null; Rest mit Dividendenvorzeichen. c[p], rest[q]. b=0: c=rest=valid=overflow=0, div0=1. MIN_p/-1: c=MIN_p, rest=valid=div0=0, overflow=1. Sonst valid=1, div0=overflow=0. Ports übertragen unsigned Bitmuster. Grenzen siehe Parameterbedingungen; maximal 512 NANDs.
